sb4.notes: Analytical parameterized model (SB_DEPTH=4 with 3-bit pointer variables)

data_q_associated_luts.notes: SB4 elevated by 3-bit pointer boundary-guard muxing artifact

reviewer_lut_decomposition.interpretation: The total mapped-LUT delta of +8 is a coincidental cancellation between real control/comparator/drain growth (+1,845 LUT4) and SB4 parameterization boundary-guard artifact (-1,837 LUT4). Real control logic grew by 72.8%.

sb8_vs_sb4_reality_check.methodology_note: The SB4 experiment is an analytical parameterized comparison against production SB8, not a physically optimized independent SB4 RTL implementation. Measured FF delta (+925 FFs) is physically exact.

critical_paths.evidence_classification: DIRECTLY MEASURED IN ISOLATION (Yosys ECP5 mapping)
critical_paths.delay_estimate_lut_depth: > 120 LUT levels (> 91k LUT4s in ECP5 mapping)
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Stateless single-cycle combinational division operator in Slice-0 ALU
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: Iterative multi-cycle or pipelined divider candidate (exact architecture/latency to be explored in Slice-1)

critical_paths.path: L1D Tag Compare & Load Hit Muxing
critical_paths.evidence_classification: ARCHITECTURAL ANALYTICAL ESTIMATE (Full core not placed and routed)
critical_paths.startpoint: Stage E effective address rs1 + imm
critical_paths.logic: DTLB CAM match -> PMP permission check -> L1D 4-way tag compare -> way hit mux -> data alignment
critical_paths.endpoint: Load retire data & Stage E stall cancellation
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Single-cycle load-use contract in 2-stage in-order pipeline
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: Separate address generation (AGU) from cache access into distinct stages

critical_paths.evidence_classification: ARCHITECTURAL ANALYTICAL ESTIMATE (Full core not placed and routed)
critical_paths.logic: ITLB 16-entry CAM compare -> PMP check -> L1I 4-way tag compare -> way mux -> pre-decode / BPU lookup
critical_paths.endpoint: Fetch Buffer enqueue / Stage F holding register
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Single-cycle fetch hit contract without skid buffer decoupling
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: Multi-stage frontend decoupling (F1 PC generation -> F2 I$ tag/data read -> D decode)

critical_paths.path: Store Buffer Parallel RAW Hazard Detection
critical_paths.evidence_classification: ARCHITECTURAL ANALYTICAL ESTIMATE (In full core context)
critical_paths.logic: Parallel 53-bit address equality check across all 8 entries -> 8-input OR reduction
critical_paths.endpoint: Store Buffer RAW load stall (dmem_req_ready_o suppression)
critical_paths.delay_estimate_lut_depth: ~12-14 LUT levels (~8.2 ns in isolated OOC P&R; core context is analytical estimate)
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Full-array RAW load hazard checking across all 8 slots in parallel
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: Banked or age-partitioned comparator array; decoupling through pipeline load queue

critical_paths.evidence_classification: ARCHITECTURAL ANALYTICAL ESTIMATE (Full core not placed and routed)
critical_paths.logic: ALU equality / signed comparison -> branch taken decision -> commit PC redirect multiplexer
critical_paths.endpoint: Stage F fetch PC redirection mux
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Branch condition evaluation in Stage E redirecting Stage F fetch
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: BPU branch prediction in fetch with decoupled branch recovery queue

critical_paths.path: TLB Internal Pseudo-LRU Age Update Path
critical_paths.logic: Pseudo-LRU age comparator chain and update tree (~271 net hops)
critical_paths.architectural_cause: Age matrix update logic, NOT the CAM address match lookup
critical_paths.slice1_recommendation: Tree-PLRU or simplified age update scheme to avoid long register-to-register age update paths

register_file.ports: 2 asynchronous read ports, 1 synchronous write port
register_file.physical_macro_feasibility: Standard cell DFFs or dual-port register file macro; feasible as flip-flops in small cores.

bpu_tables.physical_macro_feasibility: Small distributed LUTRAM or dedicated synchronous SRAM macro.

tlb_arrays.tool_mapping: Fully-associative CAM registers + distributed comparator logic (4,152 LUT4s in MMU)
tlb_arrays.physical_macro_feasibility: Fully associative CAM is strictly standard-cell / custom CAM logic; cannot use standard SRAM macros.

store_buffer.physical_macro_feasibility: Multi-port FIFO register array with associative search logic; strictly registers/flops.

l1i_cache.tool_mapping: Flattened into flip-flops & wide mux trees in generic synthesis without macro blackboxes
l1i_cache.physical_macro_reality: Qualitative expectation: 4 compiled single-port SRAM macros; zero standard-cell logic gates. No ASIC area claimed.

l1d_cache.tool_mapping: 230,787 cells (159k muxes) due to behavioral byte-write enable and combinational way hit muxing
l1d_cache.physical_macro_reality: Qualitative expectation: 4 compiled byte-masked pseudo-dual-port SRAM macros; zero standard-cell logic gates. No ASIC area claimed.

measured_evidence: Current combinational RV64M division unwinds into 91.5k LUT4s (>120 logic levels) under ECP5 mapping, dominating area and creating an unviable combinational timing path.

Store Buffer depth-4 to depth-8 expansion adds 925 FFs (939 -> 1,864 FFs). Combinational LUT decomposition reveals +1,845 LUT control/comparator growth offset by a -1,837 LUT parameterization boundary-guard artifact.
Behavioral multi-dimensional cache arrays flatten into over 230k gates in generic Yosys elaboration without memory macro compilers.
NextPNR isolated TLB Fmax (15.23 MHz) is bounded by the pseudo-LRU age update ripple (age_q[1] -> age_q[7], ~271 hops), not the CAM match lookup.
strong_architectural_inferences: Dedicated compiled SRAM macros are practically necessary for physical cache implementation in both FPGA and ASIC flows.
An iterative multi-cycle or appropriately pipelined divider is a strong candidate for Slice-1.
Deeper pipelining (such as separating address generation from cache access) is strongly indicated to break the single-cycle load-use path.
64+ entry TLBs in superscalar designs strongly favor set-associativity over fully associative CAM arrays to control timing and fan-out.
design_hypotheses_requiring_future_evide: Exact pipeline stage count (e.g. 4-5 stages) is a design hypothesis to be explored in Slice-1 architecture.
Superscalar 2-wide register file area impact is a design hypothesis until physical multi-port cell area is characterized.
Dual-ported or banked L1D routing congestion is a design hypothesis requiring physical layout evidence.

boundary_conditions: SB8 73.35 MHz is isolated OOC SB timing, NOT core Fmax.
TLB 15.23 MHz is isolated OOC TLB timing, NOT core Fmax.
PLIC 7.34 MHz is isolated OOC PLIC timing, NOT core Fmax.
BPU 51.00 MHz is isolated OOC BPU timing, NOT core Fmax.
Pure combinational blocks (control, CSR, pmp_check) do not have meaningful register-to-register Fmax under this OOC methodology.
